description: Compute per-day progress vs configured goals (kcal, protein, carbs, fat, water) for today / yesterday / last_7_days / last_30_days. Returns per-day breakdown (consumed, goal, pct, delta_to_goal), period totals, multi-day averages, days_on_target count, and locale-aware next-action recommendations (pt-BR if profile language is Portuguese, otherwise en). Read-only: no logging side effects, no explicit_user_intent required.

period.description: Window to evaluate: today (default), yesterday, last_7_days, or last_30_days. All bucketed in the active timezone.

name: nourish_goal_progress
title: Goal progress
